name: Padrones de Bureba (Spain)
description: Square green flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Padrones de Bureba (quartered with pales, a castle and a tower).
history: Municipal flag of Padrones de Bureba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Padrones de Bureba arms — quartered with pales, castle and tower
